muxt generate --use-datastar --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /page Page(ctx)" -}}<button data-on:click="{{ .Actions.Update | .JS }}">go</button>{{- end -}}
{{- define "POST /update Update(ctx, signals)" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Sig struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

// Server relies on --use-datastar auto-wrap: plain (unwrapped) template
// names must accept datastar-scoped arguments like signals and render with
// the datastar template data (regression: the default framing must apply
// during parsing, before argument validation).
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Page(_ context.Context) (string, error) { return "", nil }

func (Server) Update(_ context.Context, s Sig) (string, error) { return s.Name, nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	t.Run("signals bind on an auto-wrapped route", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/update", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"ada"}`))
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "<p>ada</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("actions render on an auto-wrapped route", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/page", nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := `data-on:click="@post(&#39;/update&#39;)"`; !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), want) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})
}
